Image Resizer

Resize one image or a whole folder in a few clicks. Set a new width or height and the other side follows automatically, scale by percentage, or enter exact dimensions. Download each result or everything as a ZIP.

How to use Image Resizer

  1. Add your images.
  2. Choose how to resize: by width, by height, by percentage, or exact size.
  3. Pick the output format and quality.
  4. Click Resize and download the results.

Frequently asked questions

Will the image be stretched?

Not unless you choose Exact width × height. Resizing by width, height or percentage keeps the original proportions.

Can I resize many images at once?

Yes, up to 100 per batch, and they can be downloaded together as a ZIP.

Does enlarging an image make it sharper?

No. Making an image larger can't add detail, so it may look soft. Resizing down gives the best results.

Are my images uploaded?

No. Everything is processed in your browser.
